findings.current: “I suspected as much, but it seems that the Fire King, that old man, really didn’t give you any warning.”
findings.defect: 언질 means prior notice or a heads-up, not a warning of danger.
findings.rationale: The line concerns Jeok Cheongang failing to tell Taekyung about the planned instruction in advance.
findings.replacement: “I suspected as much, but it seems that the Fire King, that old man, really didn’t give you any heads-up.”
findings.source: 설마 했는데 화왕, 그 늙은이가 정말로 아무런 언질도 안 해 준 모양이군.

findings.current: “You said it yourself before, Old Master. The Slaughter Saint only kills people who deserve to die. You said that made him a fairly decent assassin.”
findings.defect: The translation addresses Mungyeong as Old Master and attributes the prior statement to him. Taekyung is reporting something Jeok Cheongang—the Old Master—previously said about Mungyeong.
findings.rationale: The deferential subject marker in 노야께서 makes Old Master the subject of 그러셨습니다, not the person being addressed.
findings.replacement: “The Old Master told me before that the Slaughter Saint only kills people who deserve to die. He said you were a pretty decent assassin.”
findings.source: “전에 노야께서 그러셨습니다. 살성은 죽일 놈들만 죽인다고. 그래서 제법 괜찮은 살수라고.”

findings.current: Mungyeong looked at me with pity and continued.
findings.defect: 한심하다는 눈빛 conveys contemptuous exasperation—he finds Taekyung pathetic or hopeless—not sympathy or pity for him.
findings.rationale: The surrounding rebuke mocks Taekyung for displaying every thought on his face.
findings.replacement: Mungyeong looked at me as though I were utterly hopeless and continued.
findings.source: 문경이 한심하다는 눈빛으로 나를 바라보며 말을 이었다.

findings.current: Yeah, fuck. Blazing Flame Divine Dragon or not, I was still *you* to the Slaughter Saint.
findings.defect: The rendering flattens 나발이고 into neutral “or not,” losing Taekyung’s profane dismissal of his own grand sobriquet.
findings.rationale: 나발이고 dismissively rejects the preceding title rather than merely qualifying it.
findings.replacement: Yeah, fuck. To hell with the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon—to the Slaughter Saint, I was still just *you*.
findings.source: 그래, 시벌. 열화신룡이고 나발이고 살성한테는 네깟놈이지.

findings.current: “Would you like me to make your shoulders feel cool as well?”
findings.defect: The translation changes “above your shoulders” into the shoulders themselves, obscuring Mungyeong’s threat to remove Taekyung’s head.
findings.rationale: 어깨 위 refers to what is above the shoulders; the half-drawn short sword makes the decapitation joke explicit.
findings.replacement: “Want me to cool off everything above your shoulders too?”

findings.current: “You have achieved a considerable realm, but a martial artist and a true Murim martial artist are different. I will turn you, who are still only half-formed, into a true martial artist.”
findings.defect: The draft applies “true” prematurely to the comparison and then drops Murim from the promised transformation, blurring the line’s central distinction between a martial artist and a genuine martial artist of the Murim.
findings.rationale: The source contrasts 무인 with 무림인 and reserves 진짜 for the kind of 무림인 Mungyeong promises to make Taekyung.
findings.replacement: “You may be a martial artist of considerable skill, but a martial artist and a Murim martial artist are not the same thing. You’re still only half-formed. I’ll turn you into a true Murim martial artist.”
findings.source: “네놈은 상당한 경지를 이룩한 무인이지만, 무인과 무림인은 다르다. 아직도 반쪽짜리에 불과한 널 진짜 무림인으로 만들어 주지.”

findings.current:
> - Sudden Quest, **[Fake Murim Martial Artist]**, has been generated!
>
> **Will you accept [Fake Murim Martial Artist]?**
findings.defect: The System panel encloses the Quest title in square brackets, contrary to the required System-window formatting.
findings.rationale: The blockquote and System heading already identify the UI, so System terms must not retain outer square brackets.
findings.replacement:
> - Sudden Quest, **Fake Murim Martial Artist**, has been generated!
>
> **Will you accept Fake Murim Martial Artist?**
findings.source:
- 돌발 퀘스트, [가짜 무림인]이 생성되었습니다!

[가짜 무림인]을 수락하시겠습니까?

summary: Seven actionable findings: one speaker-identity error, one lost martial-artist distinction, and localized register, characterization, humor, and System-formatting defects.
